rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for nourishment, especially physical nutrition or what the body receives from food.

example.english: Children need balanced nourishment to grow up healthy.
example.traditional: 小朋友要有均衡嘅營養先可以健康成長。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 jiu3 jau5 gwan1 hang4 ge3 jing4 joeng5 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin6 hong1 sing4 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this for the act or resulting state of being nourished, especially for abstract nourishment such as nourishment from art or ideas.

example.english: Reading classic literature can provide nourishment for the soul.
example.traditional: 閱讀經典文學能夠滋養心靈。
example.jyutping: jyut6 duk6 ging1 din2 man4 hok6 nang4 gau3 zi1 joeng5 sam1 ling4

rows.note: Use this only when nourishment means actual food or sustenance, rather than nutritional value or figurative nourishment.

example.english: Bring enough food for the hike so we will not lack nourishment.
example.traditional: 遠足嗰日要帶夠食物，先唔會冇嘢食。
example.jyutping: jyun5 zuk1 go2 jat6 jiu3 daai3 gau3 sik6 mat6 sin1 m4 wui5 mou5 je5 sik6
